Chapter 758 Head To The Demon Realm And Find An Opportunity!

Chapter 758  Head to the Demon Realm and Find an Opportunity!

Due to the war between the Demon Realm, the Ocean Realm, and the Buddha Realm, many universes had become extremely chaotic.

The New Moon Cosmos, as the headquarters of the Demon Realm, was even more chaotic.

Roaring demonic dragons, bared tiger demons, whistling bird demons, wandering fish demons...

Almost every place was filled with an aura that made people tremble.

It was no wonder that they were like this.

This was because as the war between the demons and the Buddhas reached its climax, many great demons entered the Buddha Realm to massacre.

The buddhas were unwilling to be bullied, so they quietly infiltrated the demon world and carried out large-scale Download

enlightenment.

All free and unlocked chapters

Not long ago, there was a huge incident where all the living beings on more than ten planets were converted into Buddhas.

....

Snow Moon Hotel.

A group of armored demon beasts with beast faces and human bodies walked in.

A powerful aura surged out like a wave.

The manager quickly came up and said respectfully,"Greetings, Milord."

The demon beast standing at the front raised its head and pointed its black nostrils at the waiter."Have any monks come to your shop Milord."

The demon beast standing at the front raised its head and pointed recently?"

"No," the manager replied respectfully,"our shop never accepts monks.""

"Is that so?" " I don't believe it. Search!" The demonic beast spat out two balls of hot air from its nostrils."

"Yes, sir!" The demon beasts behind him shouted in unison and turned into wisps of black fog, rushing into every room in the hotel.

Immediately, the rooms were filled with the sound of chickens and dogs jumping. It was very chaotic.

When the manager saw this, he could only sigh helplessly. On the surface, he became even more respectful as he entertained the demon beasts.

In a room deep in the hotel.

Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian were extremely nervous.

Although they were not from the Buddha Realm.

However, they were also people that the Demon Realm wanted to capture.

However, due to the recent incident in the Buddha Realm, the capture efforts had decreased a little.

"Don't be nervous, it'll be fine," Qiu Ziqian whispered."

Lin Yulian nodded vigorously.

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, a ball of black gas rushed in.

Gradually, it condensed into a demonic beast with a tiger head and a human body.

Its cold eyes swept across the room.

When it saw Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian, it only glanced at them.

This was because they all had very long hair and did not have any Buddhist aura. They were not from the Buddhist Realm.

There was no one else in the room.

Thus, the tiger-headed demonic beast prepared to return.

It was also at this moment that it caught a glimpse of Lin Yulian from the corner of its eye.

It paused in its steps.

It suddenly realized that it seemed to have seen her somewhere before.

After a while, a wanted person overlapped with Lin Yulian and Qiu Ziqian in the mind of the tiger-headed demonic beast.

"It's you!" it shouted sternly.

As soon as it finished speaking, it pulled out the long saber at its waist and slashed at the two of them.

"Boom!"

A huge ravine was formed on the ground where the blade energy passed.

Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian used all their strength to dodge to the side.

"Whoosh!"

The demon beasts who were originally checking the other rooms thought that they had encountered the Buddhist people and rushed over.

Soon, Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian were surrounded by five demon beasts.

One of the demon beasts with a wolf head and human body said,"Sixth Brother, what's going on?"

It clearly felt that Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian were not Buddhist people.

Then, why did the tiger-headed demonic beast attack?

"They are the targets of the second level mission," the tiger-headed demonic beast said."

" Level 2 mission?!" All the demon beasts were shocked.

The Shifters had a Mission Hall with missions ranging from Level 10 to Level 1.

Level 1 was the highest level mission.

Level 2 was definitely a big quest!

Once it was completed, the reward would definitely be very generous!

Instantly, the demons looked at Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian with greed in their eyes.

It was as if he had seen two treasure chests.

Lin Yulian couldn't help but shiver.

Qiu Ziqian suppressed the fear in her heart and said,""Yulian, don't be afraid. We'll be fine."

"Are you alright?" The tiger-headed demonic beast grinned and said," It's indeed fine now. However, if you resist, that might not be the case."

"Get on the ground, or else!"

It directly raised the long saber in its hand and emitted an extremely terrifying cold air.

At this moment, a loud and clear voice suddenly sounded from behind.

"Otherwise, what?"

The demons turned around to look at the voice.

He only saw…A tall and handsome man appeared in his field of vision.

He... It was Lin Fan.

"Lin Fan!" Qiu Ziqian said excitedly.

Lin Fan's figure flashed and appeared right in front of her.

"Dad!" Lin Yulian said.

Lin Fan said," You guys have suffered."

The tiger-headed demon said,"It seems that you are not willing to be captured without a fight. Then..." Die!"

As soon as it finished speaking, it raised its saber and slashed again.

"Tsk!"

Lin Fan's eyes didn't even move as he waved his hand.

"Whoosh!"

A vast sword light whistled out and instantly covered the area. It fell from the head of the tiger-headed demon.

"Plop!"

In the next moment, the tiger-headed demon was split into two from the middle and fell to the ground, completely losing its vitality.

The remaining demons 'pupils constricted.

"What?"

"Everyone, be careful!"

All the demons drew their weapons as if they were facing a great enemy.

However, some things didn't have great effects just because one was prepared.

He saw…

Lin Fan's palm swept out.

"Whoosh!"

A sharp force swept out.

The entire space seemed to have been frozen, and all the demons stopped their movements.

In the next moment…

The bodies of the demons split apart smoothly from the middle and landed heavily on the ground, making a muffled sound.

His life force had completely dissipated!

" Zi Qian, Yu Lian, it's fine," Lin Fan said."

Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian were stunned for a few seconds before nodding vigorously.

Then, Lin Fan said," Yulian, let's go get the thing you need.""

Lin Yulian's beautiful eyes lit up when she heard this.

Then, he said worriedly,"That thing is in the Demon King Palace…" Why don't we look for another opportunity first…"

Lin Yulian had come from Earth to find the things she needed in her dream.

That thing was extremely important to her, even related to her life.

However, when she came to the Demon Realm, she became less anxious.

On the one hand, it seemed that the distance was close, so even if he did not get it, it would not be as painful as on Earth.

On the other hand, Lin Yulian knew how powerful and terrifying the demons were.

Even though Lin Yulian had seen Lin Fan's strength just now.

However, this place…After all, they were demons. Who knew how many experts there were in the Demon Palace.

What kind of eyesight did Lin Fan have?

He could easily see the worry in Lin Yulian's heart. He smiled and patted her head.""Don't worry, I'm just taking some things from the Demon Palace. There won't be any danger."
